evidence.quote: Columbia Road is in the East End, sitting at the edge of the City

findings.value: The market's Find Us page gives bus routes (the 26, 55 and 8), walking routes from nearby tube stations, and parking at Mulberry School. It says nothing about step-free access, toilets or hearing loops.

evidence.quote: Buses are the 26, 55 or the number 8.
Parking is available at Mulberry School (Gosset Street E2 6NW)

postcode (E2 7RG from the triage list is not quoted on the venue's site)
accessibility.access_page (the site has no access page)
